'''Parasitic Cysts''' (or more simply, Cysts) are a unique type of block added by the Mod. 

All [[Mobs#Parasites|Parasites]] capable of breaking blocks have an internal inventory, where they store blocks that they break. Under certain conditions, they'll empty their inventory into a Cyst and place it.

== ''Mechanics'' ==
When a Parasite breaks a block, it will be stored in its own internal inventory. When the parasite dies, despawns, its inventory becomes full, or randomly if their inventory is not empty, they will thrown down a '''Gluttonous Cyst''', which contains their inventory. Gluttonous Cysts can be accessed like a chest, having 36 slots, meaning the items within them can be taken any time. Parasites cannot break Gluttonous Cysts.

After 25 seconds, the Gluttonous Cyst will begin consuming the items within itself, consuming one item every 5 seconds. For items that have a durability, 5 durability will be consumed each second, until it breaks. For each item it consumes, it will generate 2 [[Evolution Phases|Evolution Points]]. Each time it consumes an item, black particles will appear above it, sometimes play a chewing sound, and the consumed item is lost forever.

When there are no more items it can consume, it will turn into a '''Vacuous Cyst''', which can broken by parasites. Vacuous Cysts serve no purpose, and will randomly turn into air blocks if on top of air. A Vacuous Cyst will disappear if it is in air.
